instruction:
Open /home/user/Desktop/branch_pipe.step, /home/user/Desktop/main_pipe.step using BRL-CAD. Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). On this machine, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `branch_pipe.step`.

Use BRL-CAD to read /home/user/Desktop/main_pipe.step and /home/user/Desktop/branch_pipe.step. Place two branch pipes so they intersect the main pipe at X=30 mm and X=70 mm, with both branch axes along Y and intersecting the main pipe centerline. Fuse all three pipes. Cut a through hole of diameter 12 mm along the main pipe axis through the full main pipe length. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl.
